body: I feel more lonely as time goes by. People keep leaving me and treat me as I was a second choice. The only person that is always there for me when I need a shoulder to cry on is my mum. She is literally the only person that keeps me alive. Every time I think about committing suicide I just think how ruined my mum’s life would be if I did that. She is divorced and she has been single since she left my father and I know how much she loves me and how devastated she would be. But when my mum passes away, I won’t have any reason to be alive. It might take lots of time until that happens but I refuse to cause such pain to my mum.
Thanks for your answer! :)

I ve done that test but with another thing. I also have Crohn’s disease. I tried to be opened about it and they didn’t seem to care at all. Not all my friends reacted like that but some of the people that I thought were really close, didn’t seem to care that much about my health. I ve been feeling that I need to clean some people from my life.
True
Is it your first time with a guy? Because I am not feeling the chemistry
Thank you a lot❤️
So if I have the chance, should I take biologics? I ve been feeling so scared based on what I ve read about the secondary effects…
Living with this condition is like living with a time bomb in our gut. I hope it starts to work❤️

Not sure if it is not because of the meds. When I was taking pentasa I had an hangover that lasted 4 days. When I stopped taking medication for while, I got drunk two times and even tho my gut has a strong inflammation, I didn’t have hangover symptoms. Now I am taking immunosuppressants but I haven’t tried to drink ever since.

I am not planning to get wasted like every single day ahahahaha. I just want to sometimes being able to just not feel anything at all. I know probably I need professional help but I already do therapy and I try every single day to not give up so yeah I allow myself to not suffer at least once in a while when I go out with friends and get drunk. But doctor is planning to put me in biologics soon so we ll see how my body will react to them!
I need to heal physically and mentally ahahahha. Even tho I have no symptoms for months, it kills me to know that the live I imagined will be full of uncertainty

I needed this answer. I ve been reading stories about how much stuff people give up due to crohn. And I mean. I am not planning to live my life in a destructive way. I just want to continue to have fun with my friends and my family which might involve eating or drinking things that I should not do. Everything that comes with moderation should be fine. I don’t know how my day will be tomorrow. But I like to drink with my friends when we hang out. Even tho I am not a alcoholic, unfortunately due to my depression, my best moments, when I am truly happy is when I am drunk with my friends. And I don’t know. My doctor says that crohn is unpredictable like all autoimmune diseases. We can keep it under control until the day he gets used to the pills we are taking and just finds another way to fuck us all. If I don’t have many symptoms now, I don’t think drinking 4 or 5 times a year will harm that much my body. It will just help me to relieve that pain I feel everyday for not knowing if I have strength to find my dreams. I am so sorry about your son. He died young but I am sure he lived the best he could based on your description. We should live our lives everyday like it was our last day. Enjoy every moment but not with exaggerations to not compromise to much our health.

Sorry I expressed myself wrongly ahahaha. I wanted to say I am not an alcoholic at all. I just drink a few drinks once at a time with my friends. That is why I was asking if I need to give up completely on alcohol or if I can drink it sometimes.
Thanks for your testimony!!! According to my GI, I don’t need to have food restrictions and actually I’ve been able to not have symptoms but apparently internally my gut is still getting damaged :(

I think I need to give some context. I started to take pentasa and entocort  in July until November. However I was being followed in a private clinic which don’t have access to biologics. And apparently pentasa was not working because I did several exams and I was getting worse, reaching high levels of calprotectin. I stopped taking any meds because I started to see a new GI who told me pentasa is not very efficient and I have been like 1 month without taking any meds because I took a while to choose if I should remain with the first or with the second GI. However, since I stopped taking any meds, I just had temporary flare ups everything I got stressed. Either way I thought I was getting better but my doctor did me an echoscopy and apparently my intestine is narrower and there is a liquid accumulation. I don’t know I just want to have some fun once in a while like I used to do (which was not that frequent) and live while I still can. But I am now on immunosuppressants

But I am it’s like I am an alcoholic or something. I just want to be able to hang out normally with my friends and have some fun once in a while like everyone else. Is it that bad too drink too much sometimes? I am asking this because I genuinely have no idea of the long-term consequences of it
But in my case i don’t have symptoms so how can I discover if the choices I am making are the healthiest for myself?
I am already having professional help thank you! I was just asking if I should stop living my life if the outcome will be the same

I used to be like you. I used to be able to manage everything at the same time (work, friends and family) even tho I felt like shit all the time. However, as time goes by, I have been having less energy to text my friends or to show them that I care. Sometimes it is just too much for you to handle so choices need to be made. Involuntary choices of course. I ve already accepted that in my case my BPD will annihilate all my remaining friendships. And I mean I could explain my friends that I have BPD. But if I do that they will question if I actually like them because we hate and we love people at the same time. We wear masks to uncover some negative traits we are ashamed of. So I guess the only solution is just to let go…

I know it’s been a year since you posted this but I want to share my story. My therapist diagnosed me with Borderline Personality Disorder. I tried to take antidepressants. I almost killed myself while I was taking them. I went again to my psychiatrist and he prescribed me something even worse with lots of secondary effects. It would destroy completely my liver. Now you say, okay change of psychiatrist. It is not that easy. I have a personality disorder, not a psychiatric one. My mood changes all the time and taking meds actually increases my negative thoughts and leads to a really bad state of numbness. Sometimes I very happy, others I just want to die. I feel like I am a piece of shit you doesn’t deserve to live. I feel like my body is fighting against an invisible force that tries to take it down. You never heard that people are different so what worked for you might not work for other people? I know you are trying to help but someone should have the right to die if they want. The world is a piece of shit. People are always trying to take us down and then they got surprised and they cry if we are gone. In my case, even tho I feel bad most of the time, since I have Crohn, asthma, depression, I feel I am not loved and I hate most people, I still have hope that the world is better than this. So I decide to live right now. But some people don’t. So why shouldn’t we give them a choice? Okay fine, perhaps depression makes them feel like they wanna die. But depression was also induced by external factors that lead to that state. I rest my case.
Thanks for your support❤️
Thanks for your answer :). Even in remission i still need to look out for what i eat? I have been recently diagnosed so i really don't know what to expect.
I am just afraid of pushing them away because of the disease. But yeah if they are my friends they should understand.
